title: CAPIT Terms of Use
description: The terms that govern your use of the CAPIT website, its well-record data, and any wallet-enabled features.
headline: Terms of Use
body:
Last updated: September 2026.

These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of CAPIT and any related websites, content, data views, applications, and wallet-enabled features provided by Tellus Digital, LLC ("we" or "us"). By using CAPIT, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use CAPIT.

sections.heading: Using CAPIT
sections.body: You may use CAPIT only in compliance with these Terms and applicable law. We may change, suspend, or discontinue any feature at any time.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.body: You must be at least 18 years old to use wallet or token features. You may not use them where doing so is prohibited by law, or if you are subject to sanctions.

sections.heading: Data Is Informational Only
sections.body: CAPIT compiles records published by government agencies and other public sources. Those records may be incomplete, delayed, or revised, and CAPIT may make errors in collecting or displaying them. CAPIT is not a government registry. For any decision that depends on a well's status, check the official agency record.

sections.heading: No Financial Advice
sections.body: CAPIT provides informational content and software interfaces. Nothing on CAPIT is financial, investment, legal, tax, environmental, engineering, or regulatory advice.

sections.heading: Token and Blockchain Risks
sections.body: Digital tokens involve significant risk. By using token features, you acknowledge that:
bullets: Token prices can fall, and you can lose the full amount you spend.
Liquidity may be limited or unavailable.
Blockchain transactions are irreversible, and smart contracts can contain errors.
Laws and regulations that apply to digital tokens may change.
Holding CAPIT gives no ownership of any well, share of revenue, or right to public funds.

sections.heading: Your Wallet, Your Responsibility
sections.body: You are solely responsible for your wallet, private keys, and recovery phrase, and for every transaction you sign. We cannot access, recover, or reverse anything in your wallet.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.body: CAPIT links to and integrates third-party services such as wallets, decentralized exchanges, and block explorers. We do not control them and are not responsible for their availability, security, or terms.

sections.heading: Prohibited Conduct
bullets: Interfere with or attempt to disrupt the site or its infrastructure
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to any system or data
Misrepresent CAPIT data or imply that CAPIT or any agency endorses you

sections.body: The CAPIT name, logo, mascot, site design, and original content belong to Tellus Digital, LLC. Underlying public records remain subject to the terms of their source agencies.

sections.heading: Disclaimer of Warranties
sections.body: CAPIT is provided "as is" and "as available," without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including warranties of accuracy, merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement.

sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Tellus Digital, LLC will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for any loss of funds, tokens, profits, or data, arising from your use of CAPIT.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continuing to use CAPIT after an update means you accept the revised Terms.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these Terms? Reach us through the [Contact](/contact) page.
